title: 曲線縁石と側溝
description: 恒久的な道路縁石と浅い側溝を一体化した90度コーナー部材。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A permanent 90-degree precast curb corner with integral shallow gutter; not a portable access ramp. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
